signature: export function BENCH_FN(nodes: readonly string[], edges: readonly [string, string][]): string[]
instruction: Repair {{symbol}} in {{entry}}. The two arguments are node ids in input order and directed [before, after] edge pairs. Return a stable topological order: at each step choose the earliest input node whose incoming dependencies are already emitted. Duplicate edges count once. Throw for duplicate node ids, edges mentioning missing nodes, self-edges or cycles. Do not mutate either input array or edge pairs. Treat all strings, including __proto__, as ordinary ids.
